scope: Independent verification of seven previously unchecked metadata leaves and ten named extreme single-target counts from the archived Norman2019 K562 identity CSV; dynamic legacy-checker coverage audit.
definition: Read every one of111445 CSV rows with stdlib gzip/csv. Good coverage separately counts exact True; never prefilter. Targets are sorted unique nonempty underscore tokens excluding NegCtrl prefixes and all-digit tokens. Singles count one target; duals distinct two-target sets.105 single counts sorted ascending: min/max, p10 at index n//10=10, p90 at 9*n//10=94 (no interpolation). Extremes sorted by counts then gene for deterministic ties; specified17 integer fields exactly. Cells/classes/105/median495 are anchors; legacy six existing checks are baseline.
acceptance: Exact17 fields and all-row/schema/domain anchors;17 named single-field+1 mutants rejected by semantic comparison. Unmodified legacy code bytes, preserved relative gzip layout, explicit new --result/--output paths: clean exit0/INDEPENDENT_CHECK_MATCH/six strictTrue checks; all17 mutants expected same legacy acceptance, confirming coverage gap. Legacy exit1/INDEPENDENT_CHECK_MISMATCH is valid rejection but fails this frozen expected coverage-gap contract; timeout/badJSON/otherexit is infrastructure fail-closed, never a rejection. Total verdict fails on any missing,nonfinite/domain/control/infra failure.
limits: Metadata/count arithmetic and evaluator coverage only; no expression matrix download, synthetic rerun, model fit, mechanistic, generalization, independent biological replication, human identity or clinical claims. Historical r1 E2 INCONCLUSIVE and r2 EXPLORATORY_UNVERIFIED unchanged. GEO and original Science/PMC direct reads blocked by reCAPTCHA/InternalError; inherited repository attribution/archived lawful public K562 metadata reused, with no assertion of a newly obtained GEO license. Benchmark abstract and separate Pertpy primary article read; external subset counts are not this byte-pinned file.
